source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

series.UNRATE: Civilian unemployment rate, monthly, seasonally adjusted
series.CPIAUCSL: CPI for all urban consumers, all items, monthly, seasonally adjusted
series.CORCACBS: Charge-off rate on consumer loans, all commercial banks, quarterly, SA

transformations.unemployment: quarterly average of monthly UNRATE (complete quarters only)
transformations.inflation: year-over-year % change of quarterly average CPIAUCSL (complete quarters only)
transformations.missing_months: interior missing months linearly interpolated; trailing incomplete quarters dropped
